title: Flamingo Brain Maze Runner
description: A flamingo navigates a surreal floating arena to collect glowing brain-stem orbs while avoiding a patrolling BrainStem robot guardian. The player clicks waypoints to guide the flamingo, collecting all orbs before the guardian catches it.
prompt: Create a single HTML file using Three.js r170 (via importmap from cdn.jsdelivr.net) that implements a top-down chase game on a circular floating platform. Load both GLB assets using GLTFLoader: the flamingo (shared_assets/flamingo.glb) as the player character and the BrainStem (shared_assets/BrainStem.glb) as an enemy guardian. Setup: Create a large circular disc (radius 12) as the arena floor with a dark metallic material. Place 5 glowing orbs (small emissive spheres, yellow-green color) at random positions on the platform. Scale the flamingo to roughly 0.02 and place it at the arena edge. Scale the BrainStem to 1.5 and place it at the center. If either model has animations, play them using THREE.AnimationMixer. Camera: Position an orthographic or perspective camera above and slightly angled (position 0,20,15 looking at origin) to give a clear top-down-ish view of the arena. Lighting: Add ambient light (intensity 0.4), a directional light from above-right, and point lights on each orb for glow effect. Interaction steps: (1) Player clicks on the arena floor to set a waypoint. (2) The flamingo smoothly moves toward the clicked point using lerp each frame, rotating to face movement direction. (3) When the flamingo reaches within 1 unit of an orb, the orb is collected with a scale-down animation and removed. (4) The BrainStem guardian continuously rotates to face the flamingo and moves toward it at 60% of the flamingo speed. (5) If the guardian reaches within 1.5 units of the flamingo, display a red 'CAUGHT! Game Over' overlay. (6) If all 5 orbs are collected, display a green 'YOU WIN!' overlay. Add an HTML score counter showing orbs collected out of 5. Use raycasting on the arena disc for click detection. Add a subtle fog and a starry background using a dark scene background color. Ensure the game loop runs via requestAnimationFrame with delta time from THREE.Clock.
